author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: Correction to v3.26.2: the previous release added a discount field inside the Calibration configurator box, but the actual missing 'POS discount' was the Quote tab's Calibration Options section not having the same per-section Discount (%) row every other section (Startup, Base Product, etc.) already shows above its Subtotal — confirmed from a screenshot. Reverted the wrong CalibrationBox change and added 'calibration' to DISCOUNTABLE_TYPES instead, so Calibration Options now gets the standard Discount (%) row like every other quote section. The Cost (total) / Gross margin (total) stat box from v3.26.2 is unaffected and stays as-is.
